articleTitle: Providing Electromagnetic Compatibility of High-Power Frequency Converters with Active Rectifiers at Internal Power Supply System of Cherepovets Steel Mill
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: This paper presents the method of ensuring electromagnetic compatibility of frequency converters with active rectifiers ACS6000 as a part of main electric drives of four-stand mill with 10 kV distribution network of in-plant power supply system at JSC “Severstal” Cherepovets Steel Mill. The essence of the used method was in application of improved algorithms of PWM for active rectifiers of frequency converters ACS6000 ensuring harmonic composition alteration of currents consumed by ARs with exclusion of harmonics falling into the zone of resonances in the frequency response of the network relative to sections of 10 kV GPP-2. Theoretical studies were conducted on a complex mathematical model of the main electric drives of the mill and the internal 10 kV distribution network implemented in the mathematical package Matlab-Simulink. The analysis of research results showed the effectiveness of the proposed method in terms of reducing the total harmonic distortion factor on the sections of the main step-down substation of the plant, which are intrafactory points of common connection.

articleTitle: Integrated Voltage Harmonics Factors Estimation of Multilevel Voltage Source Inverter with Common-Mode-Voltage-Eliminating Space Vector PWM
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The harmonics-related performance characteristics of the common-mode-voltage-eliminating space vector pulse width modulation (CMVE-SVPWM) technique for three-phase multilevel voltage source inverter (MLVSI), based on the recently offered quarter-wave-symmetric space vector pulse width modulation (QWS-SVPWM) algorithm, are investigated. Namely, the dependences of the output voltage THD and three low-order weighted THDs values on the phase voltage amplitude modulation index are obtained by LabVIEW simulation for the three low, multiple of 12, values of frequency modulation index and the considerably extended range of the amplitude modulation index. Like the baseline QWS-SVPWM algorithm, the CMVE-SVPWM technique keeps the quarter-wave symmetry of the star (phase-to-neutral) and delta (phase-to-phase) voltages and is intended for MLVSI of any arbitrary topology with any arbitrary number of generated equal voltage levels. The zero-common-mode-voltage MLVSI space vectors are being applied, producing the zero value of the voltage across the neutral point of the load and the inverter system ground point. To this end, relative values of the MLVSI phase load voltages, referred to the three-phase load common star point (phase-to-neutral load voltages) are being set as the reference ones and being processed.

articleTitle: Sensorless Field Oriented Control of PMSM using Direct Flux Control with improved measurement sequence
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: In this paper sensorless Field Oriented Control (FOC) of a Permanent Magnet Synchronous Machine (PMSM) is realized using the Direct Flux Control (DFC) sensorless method. In contrast with previous work, the DFC variant implemented in this paper uses an improved measurement sequence that extract the flux linkage signals needed by DFC to estimate the rotor position with the same offset level. Furthermore, based on FOC and the improved DFC, a closed speed loop is designed and tested in a simulation environment. The simulation environment uses a high fidelity Finite Element (FE) model of a PMSM that was designed in ANSYS Maxwell. The FE model is coupled with a power electronic circuit model and the control algorithm implemented in ANSYS Simplorer. Calculation of the rotor speed based on the information delivered by the DFC method is also covered. Finally, the simulation results of the speed close loop with DFC and the improved measurement sequence are presented and discussed.

articleTitle: ANN deployed DTC for Enhanced Torque Performance on IM based EV Drive
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Employing switching sector based direct torque control on electric vehicle (EV) drive is a typical approach. Direct torque control (DTC) has improved torque response in controlling the induction motor drive, at the same time, the torque ripple is also highly generated. This nonlinear variation could be regulated through various control techniques. In this paper, an artificial neural network (ANN) based speed controller is deployed along with torque reference limiter. The proposed ANN controller is mainly preferred to reduce torque ripple and to enhance the steady-state and dynamic performances of the drive system. The ANN based DTC is implemented with 270 kW induction motor drive system and simulated to verify the results. The simulation of the EV model has been developed through integrating Typhoon hardware-in-loop tool in the Matlab Simulink environment.

articleTitle: Diagnostic Possibilities of Induction Motor Bearing Currents
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The paper deals with diagnostic possibilities of induction motor bearing currents. As one of the most common electrical machine mechanical faults, failures in bearings have been the diagnostic interest for a long time. With the ever-growing amount of motors running with variable speed drives, the problems regarding bearing currents and related damages has become an important issue both in academia and industry. The paper gives the overview of the problem, describes the main related damages, as well as discusses some main direct and indirect diagnostic methods of induction machine bearing currents, usable to detect the failures in incipient stage, before the full degradation of the setup.

articleTitle: Parameter Sensitivity Analysis for 3-Φ Synchronous Reluctance Motor: A Critical Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: In this paper, a modified three-phase synchronous reluctance motor model based on stator-fluxes and rotor-fluxes in synchronously rotating reference frame is presented. Being a nonlinear system, three-phase synchronous reluctance motor state estimation is carried out using extended Kalman filter. Additionally, parameter sensitivity analysis is performed to convey which parameter is critical in case of actual motor and model parameters mismatch. Extensive simulation studies are performed under different machine operating conditions and machine model uncertainties. The simulation studies are verified on a 5.5 kW synchronous reluctance motor using MATLAB software. The validity and effectiveness of the proposed model is verified by simulation results.

articleTitle: Modified Resonant Controllers with Time Delay Compensation
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The resonant (R) controllers are widely applied to reduce ripple current/voltage in three-phase systems with power electronic converters. The digital signal processor (DSP) implementation of R-control implies a time delay due to online computation and discretization effects. The time delay produces an associated phase lag and causes deterioration of the transient operating performance as well as of the system stability. To overcome this drawback, the two modified schemes are considered in this paper for an R-control component, and one of them have never been presented before. The comparative analysis of proposed R-controllers is performed by using Bode diagrams in a frequency domain. As can be seen from the simulation results, while operating frequencies are less than the resonant frequency, a transfer function with the first order numerator is more suitable choice. In contrast, at operating frequencies exceed the resonant frequency, the transfer function with the second order numerator should be used to achieve appropriate transient performance because its frequency response is closer to the conventional R-controller. For this reason, it is more preferable to employ the R-controller scheme for digital implementation that combines simultaneously two transfer functions with time delay compensation.

articleTitle: Effect Of Data Preprocessing on the Forecasting Accuracy of Solar Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Accurate forecasting is one of the bases of the successful functioning of renewable energy sources. The use of artificial intelligence methods makes it possible to achieve high forecasting accuracy. However, the forecast accuracy depends not only on the forecasting methods used, but also on the quality of the initial data. This paper described the most common metrics for evaluating forecasting accuracy and its interpretation. Also, the frequent defects of initial data were illustrated in this paper using the example of real solar power plant generation data. The linear regression model trained using machine learning methods was used as a forecasting model. The analysis of forecasting model results was performed using the evaluation metrics which were described. By the analysis of the forecasting model results the effects of cleaning and preparation of initial data on the forecasting accuracy of a solar power plant were shown.

articleTitle: Improving the Energy Efficiency of Electric Machines For Specialized Railway Rolling Stock
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Switched reluctance motors (SRM) are increasingly used in various industries and vehicles. It is of interest to use SRM alternately in the generator and engine modes to perform various functions in vehicles. The article presents the results of research on improving the energy efficiency of SRM, which is used not only for generating electricity during the route, but also for moving to the place of loading or unloading of specialized railway rolling stock. An algorithm for determining the optimal control actions of SRM is proposed, which allows to significantly reduce the electrical losses in the winding. The calculated data on the parameters of the SRM operation in the optimal mode are presented. The optimal control problem was solved using the maximum principle. The initial conditions for auxiliary functions were determined by the Newton-Raphson method.

articleTitle: Mathematical modeling of multi-winding synchronous generators with permanent magnets for autonomous consumers
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The article discusses the possibility of using a multi-winding synchronous generator with permanent magnets to power autonomous consumers. The use of various methods of switching the stator windings is also considered to achieve an increase in generator controllability, thereby increasing the energy efficiency of the generator for the load in the power supply system of an autonomous consumer, isolated from the central power supply system. The process of developing a multi-winding generator will be shown, taking into account the position of the stator windings among themselves, with the implementation of this mathematical model in the SimInTech environment in a static mode of generator operation for an active load at a low shaft rotation speed.

articleTitle: Active Power Analysis of PWM-driven Induction Motor in Frequency Domain
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Pulse-width-modulated (PWM) voltage source inverters (VSI) are a common way to drive induction motors in variable speed applications. As switching hardware improves, motors are driven with increasing switching frequencies, extending the frequency range of PWM harmonics. Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) can be used to analyze the differences in the active power spectrum as switching frequency is changed. This paper covers the basic methodology on DFT-based analysis of input power measurements. Analysis on the input active power spectrum of a PWM VSI driven 5-kW induction motor is conducted at different switching frequencies.

articleTitle: Development of a method for reducing starting currents and electromagnetic torque of a two-phase induction motor by delaying voltage supply
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Peak current surges and weakly damped oscillations of the electromagnetic torque inevitably occur with direct start of any induction motors. This can lead to a drop in motor winding voltage, deterioration of insulation, shock, runout and resonance in mechanical equipment. This is true not only for large industrial three-phase motors, but also for single-phase and two-phase motors used in low-power household electrical appliances. In the general case, a two-phase capacitor motor can be considered with separate power supply for the main and starting windings. It can be noted that at the moment of start, before reaching a steady-state speed, any capacitor motor is identical to a two-phase one. Therefore, this article, concerning transients during direct start, is valid for both full two-phase and single-phase capacitor motors. Reducing starting loads, resonant vibrations and reducing equipment wear will always be an urgent scientific and technical task. The purpose of this paper is to develop a method for reducing the starting currents and the electromagnetic torque of a two-phase induction motor by delaying the voltage supply to the second stator winding.

articleTitle: Control System Improvement of the Electric Drive of the Pumping Unit for Oil Production
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: This article considers the technological and climatic features of oil production in the Mangistau region. The supplied electric drives of the pumping units and their remote controls are not designed for the climatic conditions of Western Kazakhstan according to the technical specifications. Imported intelligent remote controls fall into disrepair after a couple of years. In this article the authors drew their conclusions and determined the main requirements for electric drives of the Western Kazakhstan oilfield by analyzing the state of development of electric drives of the pumping units supplied from different countries. As well as the structural and virtual diagram of the electric drive of the pumping units according to the frequency converter - asynchronous motors system, the synthesis of parameters and the stability of which is solved by the method of nonlinear correction, allowing to conduct research in wide variations of the control parameters of the “frequency converter - asynchronous motors system”.

articleTitle: Forecasting Accuracy Improvement of Solar Power Plant's Generation
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Forecasting RES generation is an important task both in finding the optimal location for newly commissioned RES generation facilities, and in solving problems of existing electric power systems with a high share of RES. Therefore, obtaining high accuracy of forecasting results is one of the main conditions for the successful development of renewable energy sources. This paper studies ways to improve the accuracy of forecasting the solar power plant generation using machine learning methods. The paper describes the application of preprocessing and preparation of initial data on the forecasting accuracy. The paper also analyzes the application of three different regression models to solving the forecasting problem and gives an accuracy evaluation of each of the models.

articleTitle: Emulating Induction Machine Loss Segregation Procedure with FEM
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: This paper investigates the segregation of losses in a 5-kW IE3-rated induction machine. The stator and rotor copper, iron core, stray and mechanical losses are experimentally determined using the IEC segregation of losses-method. The loss components determined from the laboratory measurements are compared with simulated ones. Two alternative methods are used to calculate the losses using a finite element software. The first method is post-processing and the second method is to emulate the loss segregation measurement procedure. By emulating the measurements, FEM output values can be used to calculate variable and fixed losses. The results indicate that the measured losses show a good correspondence with both utilized methods.

articleTitle: Mathematical Model of a Three-Phase PWM Rectifier with Direct Power Control System
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: in the article an energy efficient electric drive system with PWM rectifier is considered. The article describes a detailed mathematical description of the mathematical model for a PWM rectifier with a direct power control (DPC) system. The paper also discusses a PWM rectifier control algorithm based on direct power control. In the article the functional and structural diagrams of the automatic control system for PWM rectifier, as well as the results of mathematical simulation are shown. The simulation results of an electric drive with a PWM rectifier show the correct work and high performance of the direct power control system. The developed mathematical model allows to significantly reduce the simulation time for complex electric drive systems in comparison with models, based on the using the SimPowerSystem library from the Simulink application.

articleTitle: Energy efficient power supply system of induction heating plant
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The power supply system presented in the article is used to power the induction converter of the induction heating plant for metal products with a discrete cross-sectional area (for example, metal balls). The system is based on an active current rectifier (CSR). This active rectifier allows maintaining the shape of the network current close to sinusoidal, as well as regulating the current at the input of the inverter of the induction converter at a given level.

articleTitle: Mathematical model of control system voltage stabilization in a limited power electrical grid
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The voltage stabilization systems are often used in electrotechnical complexes. Paper describes design a mathematical model of the system of automatic regulation of an active front-end (AFE) operating in generator mode. The main task of the control is to stabilize of limited power electrical grid when the load is connected to it in parallel. Note that the active front-end AFE model is made as four-wire semiconductor device with eight transistors connected to the reactor. The AFE control system is a control system in a rotating d-q reference frame with a rotation frequency equal to the network frequency. The control system consists of a channel for regulating the current at the output of the AFE and a channel for regulating the network voltage by controlling the phase and amplitude of the EMF of the AFE. The proposed model allows to stabilize voltage in a limited power electrical grid when a load is included in it. This makes it possible to ensure the stable operation of the entire system.

articleTitle: Methods of damping of electromechanical oscillations in a multi-motor system
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: A common problem that occurs in modern production is the presence of electromechanical vibrations, which are a source of reducing the reliability of both an individual mechanism and the entire object as a whole. Therefore, in order to ensure reliable operation of the unit, it is necessary to ensure the process of vibration damping. The paper considers several methods of damping electromechanical oscillations in a multi-motor system, and provides a comparative analysis of the proposed methods. The object of the study is a belt conveyor, which is a continuous mechanism. The conveyor is installed in the blast furnace shop of the Novolipetsk Metallurgical Plant.

articleTitle: Flux Weakening Control of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor with Losses Reduction
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Permanent magnet synchronous motors (PMSM) are used in electric locomotives, electric buses, electric cars, etc. Torque vector control strategy by flux weakening is widely used for PMSM. A flux weakening effect of PMSM is described in this paper that is implemented by increasing negative value of flux producing current component at speed value lower than nominal. The main goal of experiment was to find optimal values of that current component in order to ensure the highest efficiency and the smallest losses of motor. By setting the negative value of flux producing current component the losses are reduced. The experiments were carried out using different values of motor speed and torque producing current component. Experiment results showed that with increasing negative value of flux producing current component input power is reduced and efficiency increased consequently.

articleTitle: Method of Power Optimization of a Group of Independent Electric Drives with Periodic Load
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The article presents a description of electrical processes in a three-phase electrical network with symmetrical consumers with periodic load and methods for regulating the total active power. A mathematical description of the problem of optimizing the total active power is given. The selected optimization method has been tested. Optimization results for three, four and five power graphs of real mechanisms are considered. Computer simulation of the operation of three sucker-rod pump units with and without optimization has been carried out. The influence of optimization on the mains parameters is estimated.

articleTitle: Case Study of Supplementary PMSM for Low-Speed Wind Turbine
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: In the last decades, the renewables market is focused on distributed grids and solutions suitable for private use in households. A low-speed wind turbine based on the Magnus effect is one of the promising technologies in that area. By its construction, for the power management, Magnus effect-based wind turbine requires additional motors to control the rotational speed of the blades. An integrated motor-drive system for Unmanned Autonomous Vehicles (UAVs) matching the requirements in terms of weight, size, rotational speed, and controllability. In this case study, an application of the permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) designed for UAVs in a Magnus effect-based wind turbine prototype is presented. The control system design methodology is presented, and the performance of the system is experimentally evaluated.

articleTitle: Method for Estimating a Residual Resource of Induction Motor Winding Insulation Based on Capacitive Leakage Currents
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The paper presents an approach to estimating resource expenditure and predicting the induction motors windings insulation residual life based on the measurement of capacitive leakage currents created by a continuous sequence of rectangular voltage pulses. Experiments show an exponential decrease in leakage currents due to the development of insulation degradation processes in the long term. It was proposed to estimate the residual resource value using a modeling exponent, whose parameters are determined in the current time mode using parameter identification methods such as the least squares method (OLS) or methods based on the Kalman algorithm. The advantage of the proposed method is the comparative simplicity of the technical means used and the ability to assess the residual life of the winding insulation, relying only on the data experimentally obtained through measurement. The article describes the operation of the algorithm for the prediction of the insulation condition based on the parameters identification of the modeling exponent.

articleTitle: Robust electric drive control
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The variant of building the robust control system using the method of the polynomial equation is considered. Generalized point and interval models of the controlled plant are shown. The concept of the plant relative variation is introduced. It is shown that the use of a robust controller allows to improve the system astaticism order and significantly reduces the influence of parametric and external disturbances on the control quality.

articleTitle: Microcontroller Based P&O MPPT for Standalone Solar Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Generation and utilization of solar energy for power applications assist towards the goal of sustainability. The concern has shifted towards decreasing cost and improving efficiency. Hence, the concept of MPPT (Maximum Power Point Tracking) has been developed to maximize efficiency and provide maximized power output from solar modules. It is important to operate the solar arrays in MPP to extract maximum power leading to a lower ROI period leading to more economic benefits to the end-user therefore it is necessary to use an MPPT. The main aim of developing this project was to extract maximum power from the solar panels under varying environmental conditions by varying the conditions of the control algorithm. The algorithm for MPPT i.e., P&O is written in Arduino IDE and implemented using Arduino UNO. MATLAB/Simulink has been used for simulation of the SPV system and comparing the data obtained in simulation and in real life.

articleTitle: A New Approach to Evaluating Energy Efficiency and Energy Saving for Overhead Power Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: This paper is devoted to a new approach to evaluating energy efficiency and energy saving for overhead power transmission lines. In this study, to solve the described problems, a new approach is proposed, based on additional accounting for losses in power lines pylons and a new adapted method for calculating annual electric power losses, taking into account the induction currents in the supports. The paper presents the results of experimental studies of induction currents and heating in overhead power lines pylons. Using the heat balance equation, the problems of finding the limiting values of the power of induction currents and the heating temperature of the unit parts are solved by a graphical method. The calculation of the annual electric power losses of this type for one line of the voltage class 500 kV are presented showing a percentage between a normative value.

articleTitle: Development of Fault Diagnosis Model for Sucker Rod Pump Using Motor Power Curve
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: A real time diagnostic system development for detecting sucker rod pump working conditions is current demand for most oil producers because of significant expenses related to costs of labor and consequent damages when a fault is not identified timely. In this paper the main objective is to develop a fault diagnostic model that helps to solve the existing diagnostic problems in sucker rod pump installations. The main source of data which relays on the use of unreliable sensors is the main cause to the existing difficulties. However, motor power curve is reliable source and has a potential to improve the efficiency of sucker rod pump diagnosis. In this research, sucker rod pump simulating model generates motor power curves considering the influences of possible scenarios in the subsurface on the subsurface boundary condition. The generated motor power curves are used to train support vector machine (SVM) and for testing. The results of the simulation indicate satisfactory performance of SVMs in solving the diagnostic problem of sucker rod pumps.

articleTitle: To the development of a model for the study of overvoltage in an asynchronous electric drive with a PWM frequency converter
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Power supply of AC motors from semiconductor frequency converters with voltage inverters contains the risk of overvoltages on the supply line between the converter and the motor. The nature of overvoltages lies in the interference of the pulses generated by the converter with the signal reflected from the end of the supply line. Additionally, the amplitude can increase with superposition of high harmonics due to the phase velocity difference. Engineering concepts and research methods for these effects are well developed in relation to very extended objects and at a low frequency of the order of 50 Hz. In addition, the source of the signal is assumed to be the winding of the transformer or generator, which has a fundamentally limited rate of voltage change and is connected between the conductive elements of the electrical installation. When the line is powered from semiconductor switches (for example, IGBT), we have almost rectangular fronts and the voltage is applied to the conductive elements relative to a common point (“ground”), At the same time, for the effective use of the accumulated research complex of techniques, it is highly desirable to reduce the problem to traditional calculation schemes. This paper shows a possible reduction of the overvoltage research problem to such traditional design schemes, possibly with some reduction of parameters.

articleTitle: Approaches to Calculation of Energy Storage Capacity for Frequency-Controlled Asynchronous Electric Drive: Review
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: In the article the main approaches to calculation the nominal capacity of the supercapacitor module of energy storage for variable frequency asynchronous electric drives are discussed. A brief overview of the known procedures for calculating the nominal capacity of the module, both without taking into account and taking into account the power losses in the elements of the electric drive, is given. An example of determining the capacity of a supercapacitor module for a frequency-controlled asynchronous electric drive with a variable cyclic load is described. Energy expressions are given. The problem of accounting for losses in the elements of an electric drive is discussed. Variants of approximate calculation of power losses and the idea of an iterative procedure for a more accurate calculation of capacity are proposed.

articleTitle: Active power filter adapted to electric drive
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Currently, the most effective devices for compensating non-linear distortion and reactive power are active power filters (APF). Existing APF have complex power structures and control systems based on indirect methods for determining the required current, which increases the cost of APF, reduces their reliability and the quality of APF compensation for nonlinear distortions and reactive power. therefore, the development and research of an APF adapted for operation in the system “Frequency Converter (FC) - Asynchronous Motor (AM)”, eliminating the disadvantages of existing APF's, providing high quality compensation for reactive power and nonlinear distortions, and increasing the electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) of the system “FC-AM” with the power grid, is an urgent task.

articleTitle: Economic Analysis of Energy Scheduling and Trading in Multiple-Microgrids Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The microgrids (MGs) are considered to be a key component of future power systems. The increased integration of distributed energy resources (DER) has led to critical challenges in energy management (EM) such as uncertainty, pricing and optimal dispatch. The need for control of DER, optimal resource allocation and EM, requires interconnection of MGs, leading to formation of multiple-microgrid (MMG). One of the fundamental objective of MMG is to make optimal use of DER's within various MGs for optimal benefits. At a particular instance, some MGs might have excess energy generated, while some other MGs might buy the excess energy to meet local demands and storage requirements. The MMG facilitates energy trading between the grid and MG and amongst the MGs in order to achieve efficient energy sharing. In this paper, we evolve through different EM and scheduling strategies using visual basic for applications (VBA). The system considered has 3 MGs interconnected forming a MMG with each MG equipped with PV system and energy storage system (ESS). The objective of the strategies is to maximize the profits of individual MG while benefiting the whole MMG in total. The costs of implementing the proposed strategies are calculated and an economic analysis of various strategies is presented.

articleTitle: The Effect Of Double-Phase Auto-Reclosing Pause Duration On The Reliability And Power Transmission Throughput Under Dynamic Stability
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The article up for discusses the problem connected with the accidents of the extra-high voltage aerial line due to its large length. The lines with a voltage of 500-1150 kV, the overwhelming proportion of blackouts is caused by single-phase short circuits, much of which, being unstable arc accidents are conveniently eliminated in a single-phase auto-reclosing cycle. However, a distinct part (approximately 5-10%) is made up of double-phase short-circuits, for the elimination a high-speed three-phase auto-reclosing is usually used. The article aim is the character of dynamic transitions when using high-speed three-phase automatic reclosing and double-phase auto-reclosing of various durations and assesses the level of the transfer capacity of long-distance power transmissions (PT) of the ultra-high voltage according to the dynamic stability. Transition dynamic features in determining the accident can be traced with the help of the angular characteristics of the normal mode, double-phase short circuit mode and automatic reclosing. The main problem which arises when using double-phase auto-reclosing is successful determining the required duration of dead time in each specific projected or operated extra-high voltage aerial line. Another article purpose comparing the performance using high-speed auto-reclosing (HSAR) and double-phase auto-reclosing during two-short circuit eliminating. The article demonstrates the sufficient efficiency of using double-phase auto-reclosing when eliminating double-phase short circuit in a single-circuit aerial line with a voltage of 500 kV.

Author Keywords: pause duration of the double-phase automatic reclosing
transfer capacity of long-distance power transmission

articleTitle: Implementation of Discrete Fourier Transform in Mechanical Analysis of a Servo Drive System
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Servo drive systems may have mechanical resonances and anti-resonances that degrade the total system performance. This paper utilizes discrete Fourier transform to obtain a Bode plot of a mechanical part of a drive and to get resonance and anti-resonance frequencies. It was shown that the average speed of the motor is close to zero during the measurement, so that method can be safely used with a fragile load on the shaft. In contrast to other solutions, that method allows to obtain information quickly and analyze the system performance at a high range of frequencies. The obtained Bode plot can be used to set digital filters according to resonance and anti-resonance frequencies. The experiments proved that it is possible to measure frequency response at frequencies up to 10 kHz.

articleTitle: Analysis and Study of Cycloconverter Based on Rotating Magnetic Field Transformer
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The article discusses a method of designing a cycloconverter based on rotating magnetic field transformer. A mathematical description of such a transformer is given. A model of a five-phase cycloconverter is presented. A method of cycloconverter control is described. Study and comparative analysis of a five-phase cycloconverter with a three-phase cycloconverter are carried out.

articleTitle: Analysis of Methods for Calculating Parameters of the Equivalent Circuit of a Squirrel Cage Induction Motor
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Induction motor is a complex system, characterized by electrical, electromagnetic, mechanical and thermal processes. For an exact mathematical description of them it's requires solving a large systems of integral equations, which in some number of cases is not worth it. Today we know quite a lot of simplified techniques, which allowing us to make calculations with various of assumption, the latter in turn will lead to errors in values. In this article analyzes existing methods for calculating parameters of the replacement circuit of a three-phase squirrel cage induction motor. For selecting most precise method, the calculating of parameters of the real motor 4AA50 series was done and they were compared to catalog data. Estimation of errors introducing by various methods also was made. In result of research it was established that methods of Pantel O.V., Makeev M.C., Kuvshinov A.A., Moshinskiy Yu.A., Bespalov V.Ya., Kiryakin A.A., Gridin V.M., German-Galkin S.G. and Kardonov G.A. have the greatest error, so for calculating parameters of the replacement circuit of low-power induction motor it's more efficient to use methods by Usoltsev A.A.

articleTitle: Research and analysis of a two-circuit and three-circuit system for automatic regulation of the thickness of a reversing cold rolling mill, PJSC “Novolipetsk Metallurgical Plant”
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Single-stand cold rolling mills are units involved in the complex technological process of manufacturing finished products of a metallurgical enterprise. The quality and demand for the finished product directly depends on the high-quality work of the mill. The control system applied at the mill directly affects the accuracy of its work. The study of the existing control system is aimed at identifying its shortcomings. The facility uses a two-circuit control system, the improvement of which is proposed by introducing a third circuit operating on the basis of data on the deviation in the deformation zone.

articleTitle: Monitoring of High-Voltage Electric Drives of Pumping Units of Heat Supply Complexes of Megacities
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The sharply continental climate of the northern and central regions of the Republic of Kazakhstan has determined the relevance of improving the heat supply systems of megacities (HSSM) as life support elements in the direction of improving quality, reliability, and energy-saving. It is proposed to create a basis for solving these problems by constructing state prediction subsystems (SPS) of HSSM electrotechnical complexes using intelligent information technologies. The SPS needs to contain automatic control and monitoring facilities (ACMF). ACMF, developed in specialized software environments such as LabVIEW and MATLAB-Simulink, makes it possible to predict equipment wearout based on the monitoring of the speed modes of electric drives (ED) analyzed in the space of real and virtual coordinates of ED. Mathematical and simulation ED models are developed and a database of models is created. Intelligent subsystems for predicting the resource and reliability of the equipment increase the safety of operation of the HSSM electrotechnical complexes.

articleTitle: Research of frequency converter with vector-algoritmic control
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The article discusses the possibility of using a frequency converter for mechanisms that require several speeds of rotation, both fixed and with the possibility of smooth change. A developed frequency converter with vector-algorithmic control is proposed and the result of mathematical modeling of the proposed frequency converter in comparison with a direct-acting motor in the MATLAB Simulink environment is presented. This frequency inverter adopts a simple control system that can be executed in various ways to adjust the rotational speed of a three-phase induction motor. In addition, a physical model of a frequency converter with vector-algorithmic control was developed and assembled, and a comparison of the physical and mathematical models was made.

articleTitle: The Adaptive Starter-Generator System for Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The article presents the starter-generator system of an aircraft based on the cycloconverter with natural commutation. A feature of the system is the use of the cycloconverter with natural commutation as the main converter of electrical energy as part of the starter-generator system. At the same time the cycloconverter with natural commutation allows the starter-generator system to operate both in the mode of generating electrical energy and in the mode of electrical starting of airborne auxiliary power unit or primary motor using a synchronous generator. The scheme of the starter-generator system of the aircraft is proposed. The article presents the result of computer modeling of the studied system. The oscillograms of the output voltage and current of the system under study were obtained. The spectra of the output voltage of the system under study and the current of the cycloconverter are presented when the voltage inverter is connected in parallel. The total harmonic distortion of the output voltage is determined when the voltage inverter is connected in parallel.

articleTitle: Modelling and Analysis of Faulty Components effects on Charging in AC Grid
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: This paper proposes an approach on modelling & simulating for the behavior of different faulty states of a battery charging component and its effects on electric vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure during a typical operation & overload operation. While the world is evolving towards the electric cars, ultra-fast and fast chargers would be ruling the entire charging Industry, therefore the modelling focus is concentrated on high-power chargers. Fault in switching circuits of the EV charger module demand early detection and control for the safety of the charger, EV & AC grid. This paper discusses on specific faults probable to occur due to faulty components in the EV charger, which is analyzed and discussed with results. Studies & simulations have been carried out using Simulink - MATLAB software with Simscape & Specialized Power System library & the results are also shared for researchers to understand the test model circuit.

articleTitle: Control technique for unipolar and bipolar step motor using Arduino and LabVIEW
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: In this paper we aim to propose a control technique using low-cost Arduino Board and the LabVIEW software. Control techniques were developed for both typologies of permanent magnet stepper motors, respectively unipolar stepper motor and bipolar stepper motor. This solution is addressed to situations were rapid prototyping and accurate control is needed and at a low cost. A power driver module for the bipolar motor was developed as well. Original optimization method for improving the resolution of the bipolar stepper motor by using the microstepping control technique is well adapted for our application.

articleTitle: Synthesis of a neuroregulator with predictive control of the electric drive of the actuators of technological units of metallurgical production
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The applied development of sensorless control systems can be implemented using various mathematical approaches. When the options for the traditional synthesis of observers are not satisfactory for control purposes, other methods are used, including neural networks and neuro-fuzzy logic. The article discusses the use of a neural network approach with predictive control. The process of synthesis and training of a neural network observer of speed is described in detail, studies of the stability of the resulting object in various modes are carried out. The possibilities of the applied implementation of the obtained sensorless control system are also considered. The Matlab Simulink package is used as a software environment.

articleTitle: Features of simulation capacitive leakage currents of electric motor stator winding insulation
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The paper considers the features of building a model of induction motor stator winding insulation capacitive currents. It is shown that for the correct display of capacitive leakage currents by the model in the case of using PWM inverters, it is necessary to take into account the presence of a large number of conductors in the stator slot, which implies considering the winding phase as a long line with parameters distributed along its length, such as the active and inductive resistance of the winding itself as well as capacitive and active insulation resistance components. Such a construction of the model makes it possible to reproduce the appearance of wave phenomena of leakage currents associated with large values of the voltage derivatives, characteristic of the operation of inverters with PWM. It is also shown that for the case of supplying the stator winding from a source of industrial frequency (50/60 Hz) sinusoidal voltage, the model with lumped parameters makes it possible to provide a calculation with sufficiently accurate reproduction of the quantitative characteristics of capacitive leakage currents.

articleTitle: Current Control of a Direct Current Motor Fed through LC-filter from Power Converter Based on Wide-Bandgap Semiconducting Devices
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Wide-bandgap semiconducting devices, such as GaN and SiC switches, being used in drives affect the insulation of the motors by very high voltage derivative causing currents flowing through parasitic capacitance of the windings. This leads to fast ageing of the motor insulation and can be avoided by use of sine- or LC-filters. However, motor control through LC-filter is a challenging task requiring additional voltage sensors at the output of the filter. This study introduces an observer for motor voltage and current estimation with a help of a single current sensor between power converter and LC-filter. Together with the proposed cascaded control having three nested loops of filter current, motor voltage, and motor current the proposed solution enables conventional motor control strategies operating through LC-filter. Simulation results were obtained for direct current motor drive. Similar approach can be used for AC electrical machines including traction application with SiC inverters and servo drives with GaN switches.

articleTitle: Improving The Reliability Of STD-12500-2-Type Electric Motor Of Turbocompressors By Predicting Its State By Means Of Spectrum Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The article considers operating conditions of electric drive motors used in electric gas pumping units. A technique for predicting the technical state of high-voltage synchronous machines rested on the analysis of the dynamics of spectrum components was proposed. In the research the said technique was compaired with fuzzy models and artificial neural networks methods.

articleTitle: A technique analysis of ways to compensate high-frequency currents on traction electric machines mechanical units
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The article is dedicated to the solution of the problem of high-frequency currents influence on the mechanical components of traction electric machines while their use. It gives the analysis and solution of the problem of high-frequency current compensation, which are confirmed by the results of field tests.

articleTitle: Mathematical Simulation of Multilink Manipulator Elastic Mechanisms with AC Electric Drive
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Improvement of control systems for manipulators and robots was required implementation complex automation of production processes. It is necessary to have a reliable mathematical description of elastic mechanisms interacting during operation to solve problems of analysis and synthesis of control devices of force compensating manipulators (FCM). The work goal is the development of the mathematical description of elastic executive mechanisms (EM) of the ShBM-150M balanced manipulator. Studies have shown that low-frequency components of moved weight elastic vibrations are due to flexural deformation of a manipulator's shoulder and arm. Inertia equivalent values of manipulator links are changed by 2.2 between 3.7 times during vertical motion of cargo by manipulator with a constant weight. Total flexural deformation of shoulder and arm deflection is 25 mm during changing mass per 100 kg. And parameters of the mathematical model can be changed by 11 times, which needs adaptive control use.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Machines Used in Automotive Compressors
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Permanent magnet synchronous machines are ideal solutions to drive the scroll compressors of vehicle air conditioning systems. In the paper four construction variants will be proposed having the same stator and different rotors. These will be compared via the results obtained by means of finite element analysis. Upon the conclusions drawn, the best electrical machine choice for this particular automotive application will be proposed.

articleTitle: Induction motors for use in the strong power fields equipment for processing spent nuclear fuel in the special module of the prototype mixing device for an energy complex
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The paper presents an analysis of the temperature of the nodes of an asynchronous motor of the radiation-resistant design. Equipment for the processing of spent nuclear fuel (SNF) and the management of generated radioactive waste (RW) is placed in radiation-shielding chambers or canyons. Under conditions of constant exposure to ionizing radiation fields, there is an intense destruction of various assemblies of actuators made of organic materials, including insulation of motor windings, which leads to frequent equipment failures causing repair or replacement. Within the limits of the existing need, a project is being developed, with the purpose of creation of a radiation-resistant asynchronous electric motor with ceramic insulation for operation in. Recommendations are given on expanding the tasks of automation of the technological process, which can be provided by means of the developed control system based on software implementation. The results of the analysis of the difference of the diverted losses in the axial direction are presented. The evaluation of the effect of coolant on the temperature inside the motor was performed.

articleTitle: Experimental Results of Starting a Three-Stage Synchronous Generator Using a Reactive Torque
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: In creating a more electric aircraft, developers are increasingly applying the multi-purpose use of devices used on board the aircraft. This article considers the use of an aircraft three-stage synchronous generator as a starting device for a gas turbine engine. A number of launching devices used on board the aircraft are considered, for the analysis of launching devices and the formation of requirements for the developed electric launching devices. The problems associated with the use of a three-stage generator are analyzed, and ways to solve them are proposed. The article presents a method for generating the starting torque using the reactive component of a synchronous generator. The article contains the results of a physical experiment of the start-up system operation, the model is represented by a three-phase voltage inverter with a microprocessor control system operating on a three-stage synchronous generator.

articleTitle: Analysis of the impact on the power system of a metallurgical enterprise of the start-up modes of an electric drive of an air centrifugal compressor based on a high-voltage synchronous motor
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Metallurgical production includes many interrelated, complex technological processes, ensuring the flow of which depends on the reliable and stable operation of the power system. The process of operation of electrical equipment and machines of individual technological units should completely exclude the impact on the overall power supply system. One of the energy-intensive elements of any production is high-voltage synchronous motors of electric drives of powerful pumps, compressors and fans. The start of this type of machine is usually accompanied by high starting currents, which in turn leads to drawdowns of the supply voltage and generally negatively affects the operation of the power system. This article examines the power supply and control system of a synchronous electric drive of an air compressor using Matlab Simulink programs, as well as the search for an optimal solution to limit the loads on the power supply system and the electromechanical complex as a whole.

articleTitle: To the calculation of the magnetic conductivity coefficient of the combined multifunctional brushless activator for various ways of constructing an anchor winding of inductor axidator
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The paper presents an analysis of the influence of the shape of the tooth-slot layer on the coefficient of magnetic conductivity. The results of calculating the slot conductivities of the inductor exciter are presented. The implementation of typical equations that determins the ratio of magnetic conductivity of the slot scattering in each section of the tooth-slot layer is evaluated.

articleTitle: A DTC-model for Electrical Drives Teaching
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Effective and educative induction motor (IM) Direct Torque Control (DTC) simulation with Simulink software is presented. Motor model is realized in stator reference frame and the inverter modulation is controlled with DTC principle. Inverter non-idealities are neglected and inductances and resistances of the motor are considered as constants. The DTC model is created with multiple subsystems which allows to break down the whole control system to smaller and easily understandable parts. This way the basics of the DTC can be comprehended easier, and the model used in the education of electrical drives. In addition, the Simulink model utilizes only the basic Simulink blocks, so no additional libraries are required.

articleTitle: Dynamic Voltage Restorer using SRF Controller to mitigate Sag/Swell in Industrial Drive Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Industrial electricity users steadily expressed concern about energy efficiency in recent years. Modern enterprises use sensitive electronic power devices, control systems and nonlinear charges to improve energy efficiency and productivity as part of automated processes. Due to the greater use in industrial systems of advanced and sensitive electronic equipment, voltage disruptions have become the most important concern for power quality. A new device that defends sensitive industrial loads against voltage slopes / swells and other stress disruptions is the Dynamic Voltage Restorer (DVR). DVR configurations and control schemes are determined by the specification and characteristics of the load to be protected. Due to the inherent inertia and the ability of induction engines to withstand shorter-term, shallower swells and their phase-angle-hop resistance, induction motor cargo industries need a completely new approach to designing and operating a suitable DVR. This paper proposes a DVR with a quick response, simple and effective controller to satisfy the voltage repair requirements for induction drive applications.

articleTitle: The Research Of Increase Of Torque Of Synchronous Motor In The Field Of Small Slip Values
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The article deals with the method of increase of torque of synchronous Motor in the field of small slip values. It has been found that the maximum torque of the SM is achievable via control by output voltage of the three phase thyristor dual converter (TDC) in the function of the load angle and phase-frequency characteristics of the excitation winding. Revealed are correlations between changing SM torque at small slip values and the amplitude of the first harmonic component of the TDC output voltage. Control angles are presented, which facilitate controlling by output voltage with thyristor dual converter resulting in maximum increase of the SM torque.

articleTitle: Synchronous automatic transfer switch by programmed trajectory movement control for distributed generation
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Power supply reliability of consumers is primary task in power engineering. Reliability improvement can be achieved by the reliabilization of individual components of electrical grid and, also, by the redundancy. The redundancy is completed by automatic transfer switches. The application of automatic transfer switches is of particular interest in distribution electrical grids with operative generators. The matter is that, at those load buses when generators are connected and operated, the process of automatic transfer is becoming more involved owing to the need of a synchronism checking. Basically, capabilities and qualities of modern automatic transfer switches with synchronism checking are accurately corresponded to specified requirements. However, the operation procedures of the synchronization are still not fully developed. Therefore, authors of this paper analyze the possibility to develop and apply a technique of automatic control for synchronous automatic transfer switch at the substation with distributed generation. The bottom line of the technique is to decompose the general task of control system synthesis for the subtask of programmed trajectories formation of technical object's movement, and the subtask of control actions formation. In a paper, authors give practical example of programmed trajectory formation of controlled generator and the result of a simulation of generator's controlling in automatic transfer switch cycle.

articleTitle: Instant and seamless closing of control system of IPMSM after open-loop starting
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Nowadays, position sensorless permanent magnet synchronous motor drives are gaining popularity quite rapidly and became almost a standard in many applications like compressors, high speed pumps, etc. All of those drives involve estimators to calculate speed and position of rotor, which are necessary for proper operation of vector control. At the same time, these estimators, except injection-based ones, work well in the middle and high speed range and cannot operate at low speeds. In order to overcome this problem, sensorless control systems include different starting techniques, where the most popular is open-loop starting. In this approach, the motor is accelerated in the open-loop mode until the speed, where estimator operates stably and then the control system is closed. However, the weakest point of this method is technology of closing the system, which typically creates transients and even can be a cause of losing stability. This paper proposes a method for instant and seamless transition from open-loop to closed loop, which perfectly works under different load conditions. The authors consider other starting techniques and compare them with a proposed method.

articleTitle: Sensorless Rotor Position detection of Synchronous Machine using Direct Flux Control – Comparative evaluation of rotor position estimation methods
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Direct Flux Control (DFC) is a sensorless method that replaces position sensors in permanent magnet synchronous machines (PMSM). Direct Flux Control extracts the flux linkage signals of machines which have the neutral point accessible and afterwards uses those signals to estimate the rotor position angle. In DFC, the flux linkage signals are obtained measuring the voltage between the neutral point of the machine and an artificial neutral point at particular states during the inverter pulse pattern. This paper presents a comparative evaluation of the different estimation methods that exist within the DFC framework to calculate the electrical rotor position using the flux linkage signals. The comparative evaluation is carried out using a high fidelity software simulation. A finite element model of a Wound Round Separated Excited Synchronous Machine was created, simulated and validated in ANSYS Maxwell. Power electronics, measurement circuits, control and modulation algorithms were modelled and simulated in the software Simplorer. The simulation of DFC is made possible through a co-simulation between the ANSYS softwares' Maxwell and Simplorer. In the simulation developed, DFC is implement using space vector modulation as modulation method to command the synchronous machine with an improved measurement sequence that obtains the flux linkage signals with the same offset level. Using the simulation results, the comparative evaluation shows that among the four existing methods to estimate the rotor position from flux linkage signals, the highest flux linkage signal produces the most accurate rotor position estimation.

articleTitle: A Comparison of the Vector Control of Synchronous Reluctance Motor and Permanent Magnet-Assisted Synchronous Reluctance Motor
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Field-oriented control presents a highperformance control method that is applied for many motors. In this paper, the comparison of the field-oriented control of synchronous reluctance motor and permanent magnet-assisted synchronous reluctance motor is carried out. The highlighted features of the field-oriented control of the two motors are studied and the similarities and the differences are investigated. The motors are modeled and controlled in the Plecs simulation platform. The simulation results are verified by the experimental tests.

articleTitle: Power Hardware-in-Loop Implementation for Power Grids and Devices: Report and Review
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The recent trend in de-carbonization and digitalization of the utility grid has created a new research area where the integration of multiple energy sources is to be studied. With the increase in the utilization of renewable energy sources, Microgrids have become the current standard for grid operation in many countries. This will require a tremendous amount of testing and validation for the new management methods and the newly invented power devices. This could be achieved by employing Power Hardware in Loop (PHiL) facility which can reduce the cost and increase the fidelity of the test. This paper will attempt to address the new studies conducted in the field of power system simulation and testing using PHiL technologies. Furthermore, it will point out a possible future development and work that our research team currently exploring.

articleTitle: Short review of development approaches of mathematical models for induction motor nonsymmetrical modes research
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Study review is given for mathematical models dedicated to induction motor non-symmetrical modes research. Papers are reviewed, featuring mathematical models based on magnetic-coupled electrical circuits theory, magnetic circuits theory, symmetrical components method. The article works out the possibility of studying various complexity non-symmetrical modes of induction machine. The conclusions and the summaries describing differences and peculiarities of these approaches are also formulated.

articleTitle: Energy Transmission Test Stand for Battery-Powered Railway Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: For replacing diesel locomotives with battery-electric alternatives, a new system is introduced that relies on energy transmission via head-end power interface. The system consists of a battery storage unit, an inverter as well as filter components, and galvanic isolation. An important aspect is the reuse of main components for keeping the environmental impact as low as possible. In order to test its practicability, the concept is set up as a laboratory test stand. As the main parts of the equipment have been in use already, determination of their condition is necessary respectively modifications are required. The essential components of the laboratory set-up are an 800 V lithium-ion battery (LIB) storage unit, a gate turn-off (GTO) thyristor H-bridge, and passive filter inductors and capacitors. The LIB energy storage consists of 32 reuse modules. A second test environment is set up for determining whether a battery module is suitable for a second life cycle. For this purpose, a low-voltage high-current DC switch on basis of MOSFET semiconductors was designed and implemented. Furthermore, during testing and operation all LIB modules were monitored by a custom-made supervision circuit that reacts to any irregularity by shutting down the system. Two GTO inverters had to undergo modifications as in their original design they were used as a 3-level neutral point clamped (NPC) inverter leg. After surveying the state of the GTO inverters, they were formed into 2-level H bridges by applying minor changes. The original asymmetrical snubber circuit could be reused for the new topology. One of the inverters was used as solid-state switch for the battery while the other was used as an inverter for generating a 16.7 Hz AC voltage. It could be shown that a reuse of power electronics and lithium-ion batteries is possible as long as the components properties are taken into consideration. Also, the identification of a non-reusable LIB was shown and the properties of such a cell were measured.

articleTitle: Review of Methods for Determining Parameters of Synchronous Generators Computational Model
publicationTitle: 2021 XVIII International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: A synchronous generator has a significant impact on the stability and reliability of consumers' power supply. At present, the problems of emergency and operational control of power systems are being solved on the basis of computational models. The parameters of such models are determined using reference data or test data. The parameters of generator models are highly dependent on external factors. The presence of this dependence leads to a significant decrease in the accuracy of solving the problems of power system control. Currently, identification based on traditional telemetry systems or synchrophasor measurements is used to improve the accuracy of the power systems computational models parameters. This research aims to analyze the studies, the authors of which have developed methods for determining the parameters of a synchronous generator based on measurement data. In the research, both Russian and foreign works are analyzed and grouped. For each group, the advantages, disadvantages, as well as the area of application were identified. It was concluded that the existing methods for determining the parameters of synchronous generators from the measurement data are not able to change in accordance with the set of initial data. In addition, the research has shown that these methods require significant computing power. The adaptive model of a synchronous machine is proposed as a way to overcome these disadvantages.
